status: M11 Stage 2, second content pass (curriculum-expert, 2026-11-16). Data only: no generator reads this file yet. `patch` holds the second honest tag of Band B taps that stay (V6), merged into the item the Band B generator makes; it needs only a loader. `replace` holds the 29 swaps that waited for a template feature (step 2.2: prefilled frames and given cells; LOG-A-04: the pattern-strip sprites). Each keeps its id, is revision 2, and says in `waitsFor` what it needs. Hebrew is a pointed draft (the pack's own pointing where the words already exist).
howToRead: patch: {activity id: fields}. The fields replace the generated item's own (tools/band_b.py makes the item as today, then `item.update(patch)`), so `options` and `tags` are given whole.

replace: {activity id: a whole unit-spec item in author.py form}. It replaces the generated item as tools/band_b_recuts.py RECUTS does (same id, its lesson place and band kept, revision 2). A Band A id (logic.json) replaces the item there in the same way.

give with `prefilled: k`: the ten-frame starts with k objects in it (they cannot be taken out); `n` is how many the child adds; the source pile holds `source`. Classifiers as today: took_all, took_more, took_fewer.

build with `given`: one entry per place, a sprite for a place that is filled from the start (the child cannot move it) and null for a place the child fills; `sequence` is the whole row, so the answer is the null places of it in order. `palette_tags` (sprite: tag): the tag a wrong placement of that card records, before the item's own `tag`.
sort cards `strip_*`: pattern strips the design-director draws (a row of six small tiles on one card), named by what they show.

sprites.strip_red_blue: red ball, blue ball, repeated three times (repeats)
sprites.strip_green_yellow: green ball, yellow ball, repeated three times (repeats)
sprites.strip_mixed_balls: red, blue, green, red, yellow, blue balls (does not repeat)
sprites.strip_mixed_things: star, apple, fish, cat, apple, star (does not repeat)
sprites.strip_red_blue_slip: red, blue, red, green, red, blue: one cell breaks the unit (does not repeat; put in 'repeats' it records M-PAT-UNIT)
sprites.strip_cat_dog_slip: cat, dog, cat, dog, duck, dog: one cell breaks the unit (does not repeat; M-PAT-UNIT)

waivers.note: Taps that stay with no second honest tag (a false diagnosis is worse than none, as tagWaivers in arc_checks.dart). For the app-developer to add to tagWaivers when these lands join arcDomains, each with this reason.
waivers.b.colb03.6: light red asked; no shade of a hue near red exists (no pink or orange shades); the plain purple shows no catalogued error
waivers.b.mathb10.4: equal groups, how many in all: answering one group's size or a wrong group count has no catalogue tag (a proposal: M-GRP-ONE, counts one group only)
waivers.col.world.banana.ripe: the colour of a ripe banana: green (unripe) shows world knowledge, not a catalogued colour error
waivers.col.world.grass: the colour of grass: red shows no catalogued error
waivers.col.world.sun: the colour of the sun: green shows no catalogued error
waivers.math.graph.apples: a picture graph of equal icons: the shorter column has no honest tag, and drawing its icons bigger (the M-CNT-SIZE trap) would teach a misleading graph
waivers.pick.red.flower: the hand-made butterflies file (content/starter, no unit spec): the yellow flower shows no catalogued error
